svg.aria-label: Simulated mass balance for a mixture containing 60% polymer, 8% water, 12% added carbon and 20% stable inorganic material. A polymer char yield of 0.1 produces char equal to 6% of the initial mixture mass. The right panel holds the stage losses at 54% and 18% while varying the independently specified char yield, showing how this assumption changes the inferred composition.
